neighbours.label: ' like' / ' such as' introducing examples of a category
fire: Some fruits have odd names like rambutan and mangosteen.
Many cities, like Lisbon, are built on steep hills.
She enjoys cold-weather sports such as skiing and curling.
Old cars like the Beetle are easy to repair at home.
Some birds, like penguins, cannot fly at all.
The shop sells spices such as cumin, saffron and clove.
Small countries like Malta rely heavily on tourism.
Certain metals, like gold, never rust.
quiet: Some fruits have odd names and strange shapes.
Many cities in Portugal are built on steep hills.
She enjoys cold-weather sports during the long winter.
Old cars are easy to repair at home with basic tools.
Some birds cannot fly at all and live on the ground.
The shop sells spices from all over the world.
Small countries rely heavily on tourism for income.
Certain metals never rust even in salty air.
